hard_cut.usage: Default cut between complementary shots; instant surprise, prompt action, hard reality check.

match_cut.usage: Matching visual geometry or motion direction between disparate realms (e.g. human hand -> mechanical relay; mouse click -> remote cloud execution).

sound_bridge_cut.usage: Audio of the upcoming shot (keystroke, terminal bell, server whine) begins 250ms before the visual transition.

cut_to_black.usage: Instantaneous blackout punctuating core questions, paradigm shifts, or uncomfortable revelations.

cross_dissolve.usage: Restricted strictly to temporal ellipses, historical archival transitions, or deep time shifts.
